The **Red Rocket Filling Station** is a location in the Ash Heap region of Appalachia.

A small gas station just off the state route, this Red Rocket was used as a staging area during the Automation Riots, now slowly disappearing beneath the dust of the Ash Heap.

The original filling station building is boarded up. There is a shed with a U-Mine-It! Vending Machine outside, while random loot and a stash box can be found inside. Behind the boarded-up station, there is a Power Armor Station.

- Power Armor Chassis with T-series armor pieces - In a Power Armor Station behind the boarded-up brick filling station and the orange fuel tanks on the north side.
- Potential Vault-Tec Bobblehead - On the roof of the filling station, on the southeast corner.
- Potential Magazine - On the raised concrete portion of the metal maintenance garage, in the narrow gap between two green cabinets, near the stash box.

The Red Rocket Filling Station appears in *Fallout 76*.
